issues.legal_issue: A minister may decide a statutory appeal concerning dismissal from government service on behalf of the constitutional head, even when the appeal involves a quasi-judicial hearing, because the dismissal function remains executive.
material_facts: A confirmed government officer was dismissed after a departmental inquiry, and he appealed to the President under the applicable service rules.
After an earlier court decision required the appellate authority to reconsider whether dismissal was excessive, a minister heard the appeal on the President’s behalf and the appeal was rejected.
The rejection was communicated as the President’s order, stating that the submissions and the severity of the penalty had been considered.
issues.conclusion: The minister’s disposal of the appeal was a valid disposal by the President; there was no delegation or constitutional infirmity.
issues.legal_principle: Under Rule 23(2)(b) of the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1957, an appeal concerning dismissal was to be made to the President. The Court applied Shamsher Singh v. State of Punjab: the President is the constitutional or formal head and ordinarily exercises powers on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers; under the rules of business made pursuant to Articles 77(3) and 166(3), a minister’s or officer’s decision is the decision of the President or Governor. Appointment and dismissal of government servants are executive functions, and a preceding or accompanying quasi-judicial inquiry does not change the character of that function.

rule.if: government_service_dismissal_appeal and dismissal_function_is_executive and constitutional_head_acts_on_ministerial_advice and minister_considered_appeal

predicates.government_service_dismissal_appeal: A government servant challenged dismissal through an appeal provided for under the applicable service arrangements.
predicates.dismissal_function_is_executive: The function under review concerned the appointment or dismissal of a government servant and was executive in character.
predicates.constitutional_head_acts_on_ministerial_: The constitutional head exercised the relevant function through the advice of the Council of Ministers.
predicates.minister_considered_appeal: A minister considered the government servant’s appeal, including the submissions made and the penalty imposed.

issues.definition: When a government-service dismissal appeal concerns an executive function exercised by a constitutional head on ministerial advice, and a minister considers the appeal, the minister’s decision is a valid disposal by that head.
